name: Spray of Salt

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
A wave of purified salt burns away moisture and wickedness, dealing 5d4 acid damage. Each creature within the area must attempt a Fortitude save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage. If the creature has the ooze, unholy, or water trait, it also takes @item.leveld4 persistent,spirit damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, and double persistent damage if it has the ooze, unholy, or water trait.

---
Heightened (+1) The acid damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
